title: Carrying an orb without draining it
target: How to get use out of the orb in R.E.P.O. given that it runs on a battery, has two modes and absorbs valuables rather than simply sitting there.
version: 0.4.0, read from the copy of the game this site was built from (see the sources page)
prerequisites: Spare batteries or a charging station

steps.do: Decide which mode suits the room before you switch it on.
steps.because: the game keeps two kinds of orb, a constant one and a pulsing one (OrbType)

steps.do: Leave it off when there is nothing to collect.
steps.because: the orb drains a battery at a rate of its own (batteryDrainRate)

steps.do: Carry spares, since the orb is one of the items that makes charge matter.
steps.because: the orb has a battery drain preset like other gear (batteryDrainPreset)

steps.do: Listen for it starting and stopping rather than watching it.
steps.because: starting, shutting down and idling each have their own sound (soundOrbBoot)

steps.do: Give it room to work rather than tucking it into a corner.
steps.because: the orb has a radius rather than acting on one point (orbRadius)

commonMistakes: Leaving the orb running in an empty room.
Setting out without a spare battery.
Standing outside the radius and assuming it is broken.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
